input.title: Remember the last export format chosen in the browser
input.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

ExportButton currently always initializes its format select from the defaultFormat prop ("csv"), so the user's last choice is lost on every page load. Persist the chosen format to localStorage (e.g. under a key like "ledgerline.export.format") on change, and read it back as the initial state instead of defaultFormat when present, so the format menu remembers the user's last selection across visits.

text: This confirms the feature request location. The format state resets each render with defaultFormat="csv" and nothing persists it to localStorage.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

ExportButton always starts from the `defaultFormat` prop ("csv") instead of remembering what the user picked last time. The fix is to persist the chosen format (e.g. to localStorage) whenever the select changes, and initialize state from that stored value when present, falling back to defaultFormat otherwise. Opened a draft PR with this proposal.

Triage of issue-4405 is complete:

- **Label:** feature
- **File:** `src/components/ExportButton.tsx` — the export format `<select>` initializes from a hardcoded `defaultFormat = "csv"` prop rather than any persisted preference, which is why it resets every visit.
- **Pull request:** pr-30 opened on branch `repomind/issue-4405`, proposing to persist the user's chosen format (e.g., in localStorage) and use it as the initial state.
